1.2.3.3-f11.accuracy_reason: Virgil, Georgics 2.272 reads 'adeo in teneris consuescere multum est', not 'adeo a teneris assuescere multum est'. The note puts Burton's wording into Virgil's mouth. The other claims (the misprint, Ovid, Met. 7.20–21, and the main text rendering only the first sentence) are right.
